exposure: Timing of maternal infection relative to delivery (<=14 days)
Neonatal gestational age status (preterm vs. term)
outcome: Proportion of neonates tested for SARS-CoV-2
cohort: The study included 28,771 neonates born to people with SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy, identified from the Surveillance for Emerging Threats to Mothers and Babies Network (SET-NET) data.
finding: Among tested neonates born to SARS-CoV-2 infected mothers, neonatal SARS-CoV-2 infection was uncommon but was more frequent among those born preterm and when maternal infection occurred around the time of delivery.
cross-section timing: Data collected from 20 January 2020 to 31 December 2020
gest_age: The study included both preterm and term neonates, noting preterm neonates had higher infection rates.
